prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one pixel-art inventory icon for the game Black The Survival. Image 1 is the original Eternal Return 생사부 icon used only as a silhouette/color reference. Image 2 is our existing game icon contact sheet used only as a pixel-art style reference. Create a NEW single standalone icon matching this existing coarse pixel-art family, not a collage. Subject: An ornate cool blue and indigo circular crescent emblem surrounding a pale icy lotus; preserve its moon-ring and blue lotus silhouette. Composition: centered, occupies roughly 80% of a square, readable at 32x32 logical pixels. Style: authentic 32x32 game sprite enlarged with sharp hard-edged square pixels, limited 12-18 color palette, stepped outlines and deliberate clustered highlights. Keep the original equipment's recognizable form, angle and major colors. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no square tile, no UI frame, no words or letters, no watermark, no additional items, no smooth airbrush, no antialiasing.
